snippet.title: The Orphaned House - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Charm Games is proud to present our new game: The Orphaned House, a first-person adventure coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Epic Games Store in 2027.

Add it to your wishlist to get the latest news and updates! 

Wishlist The Orphaned House: 
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4269240
Epic Game Store - https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-orphaned-house-a70847
PlayStation 5 - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020296
Xbox Series X|S - https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9plsq6ntn6p1

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
